Choosing between the AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 has mainly come down to fit, features, and price. While Apple's camera-equipped AirPods with Visual Intelligence are in development, they're unlikely to arrive until 2027 at the earliest, so waiting could feel like an eternity.

AirPods 4 emphasise comfort and value, offering different options

The AirPods 4 use an open design and are a solid recommendation if you don't like ear tips. Our AirPods 4 review found the redesigned shape comfortable to wear without sacrificing everyday convenience.

The $129 model comes with the Apple H2 chip and personalised spatial audio, offering up to 5 hours of listening time. However, it lacks Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, and wireless charging.

The $179 model adds useful noise cancellation without sealing off your ear canal, along with Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

The open design will always let in more ambient sound, so noise cancellation takes a hit on planes or public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 are the most feature-packed option

The AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249 on Apple's website, though Amazon often offers discounts. Their foam-tipped ear tips deliver stronger bass and noticeably better noise cancellation. Apple says they last up to 8 hours with ANC on, compared to just 4 hours for the AirPods 4 with ANC.

The earbuds can detect heart rate during workouts and support Apple's Hearing Test, hearing aid features, and hearing protection. Our AirPods Pro 3 review found their workout heart rate readings were largely consistent with Apple Watch data.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 adds custom EQ to both models, while the AirPods Pro 3 get extra advantages thanks to their heart rate sensor and new charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, details about AirPods with Visual Intelligence leaked from a video hidden in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate. The clip appears to show someone asking Siri to remember a book using Visual Intelligence through camera-equipped AirPods, prompting speculation the product could launch soon.

However, subsequent reports poured cold water on that. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that camera-equipped AirPods won't arrive until 2027. The B790 model shown in the video is reportedly a modified version of the AirPods Pro 3 that has been dropped from Apple's 2026 roadmap. Apple is still working on a newer B798 generation.

Which AirPods should you buy?

If price matters most and you don't need noise cancellation, go for the $129 AirPods 4. If you prefer the open-ear fit, go for the AirPods 4 with ANC.

For everyone else, the AirPods Pro 3 remain the best value, especially when Amazon drops them close to the price of the AirPods 4 with ANC. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, heart rate monitoring, and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods pricing

  • AirPods 4 ($99, was $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC ($148.99, was $179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, was $249)

Unless Visual Intelligence is essential for you, waiting doesn't make much sense. Anyone who needs new earbuds now could be waiting over a year for that unannounced feature, missing out on tangible benefits like better noise cancellation and longer battery life in the meantime.

Otherwise, just buy based on what you need today. Today's discounted AirPods already meet the practical needs of most buyers, and the future camera-equipped model will likely cost more and sell closer to full price at launch.
